name: core_IID
title: IID core results
caption: Accuracy is percent; damage is percentage points. Honest noise/stripe accuracy uses affected clients’ legitimate tasks. All plotted cells have five blocks. FLAURA/FedCognis noise cells were not tested. Intervals are exploratory, not simultaneous.

name: core_non_IID
title: non-IID core results
caption: Accuracy is percent; damage is percentage points. Honest noise/stripe accuracy uses affected clients’ legitimate tasks. All plotted cells have five blocks. FLAURA/FedCognis noise cells were not tested. Intervals are exploratory, not simultaneous.

name: core_trajectories
title: Core learning trajectories
caption: Four clean warm-up rounds precede interventions at round 5. Curves show all clients for clean/attack and affected honest clients for noise/stripes. Shading is pointwise across five blocks, not a simultaneous confidence band. Five blocks are repeated runs, not additional rounds.

name: paired_v06
title: v0.6 paired comparisons
caption: Differences use the same five block/seed pairs. Accuracy benefits are positive; damage benefits are negative. Intervals are exploratory, assume approximately normal independent block differences and have no table-wide coverage.

name: label_flip_blocks
title: Every label-flip trajectory
caption: All five known development blocks are shown separately. Attack starts at round 5 and continues through round 24. No block is omitted and there is no inference from a single final round.
